chosen_line.card: All Streams Flow to the Sea

answers.q1_what_did_you_play: I played Gorou — Inuzaka All-Round Defense into Nibbit, then Send the Runner, exhausting Coral Guard. After drawing, I played Tidal Barrage into Nibbit and exhausted the drawn card, then played All Streams Flow to the Sea into Nibbit.
answers.q2_other_line_considered: I seriously considered playing Coral Guard, Gorou — Inuzaka All-Round Defense, and All Streams Flow to the Sea, preserving more HP while still dealing damage.
answers.q3_what_it_gave_up: It gave up Coral Guard's 5 Block and therefore took the full 12-damage attack, in exchange for increasing Tidal Barrage through multiple Exhausts and leaving Nibbit much closer to defeat.
answers.q4_different_intent: Yes. If Nibbit had telegraphed a larger attack that threatened lethal or substantially more HP loss, I would have included Coral Guard; with no incoming attack, I would still favor the damage line.
